title: Investigation and Review into Fraudulent Claims for Government Schemes
what_it_is: Investigation and Review into Fraudulent Claims for Government Schemes

sections.label: Wage Credit payouts and clawbacks
sections.summary: Over $4.7 billion in Wage Credit payouts went to employers from 2014 to 2017, while IRAS denied or clawed back $5.57 million and found over 1,000 non-compliant cases.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: A total of more than $4.7 billion in Wage Credit payouts has been given out to employers from 2014 to 2017.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: Over the same period, which is from 2014 to 2017, the Inland Revenue Authority of Singapore (IRAS) denied or clawed back $5.57 million of WCS payouts.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: IRAS found a total of over 1,000 cases where employers either gave false information or contrived to fraudulently obtain payouts that they did not qualify for or which were otherwise non-compliant.

sections.label: IRAS prosecutions for fraud
sections.summary: IRAS has prosecuted 13 cases for fraud under the PIC scheme and one case under WCS.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: To date, IRAS has prosecuted 13 cases for fraud under the PIC scheme, and one case under WCS.

sections.label: Risk-based approach to audits
sections.summary: A risk-based approach means sampling by risk rather than 100% checks, with IRAS auditing 98,000 higher-risk cases and sampling lower-risk cases less.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: Taking a risk-based approach means not 100% sampling.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: As Minister Ong Ye Kung earlier mentioned, doing 100% checks is going to be counter-productive to a large extent because it will entail a large bureaucratic process.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: So, taking a risk-based approach means sampling according to risks and when IRAS says that it has done audits for 98,000 cases, then it has identified these as the higher-risk cases and done detailed audits on them.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: To the extent that there are cases with lower risks, then the sampling will be lower as well.
